intermittent fasting, veganism, giving up
carbohydrates or taking supplements. The truth is, it is difficult to find a

under the aegis of the Indian Council of Medical

should be eating clean with easily accessible resources
and, most importantly, what suits their body type.

mother and child is linked not only to proper
growth and development but also to the risk of diabetes, hypertension and
heart attack later in life.

burden of heart disease, high blood pressure and prevent
premature deaths. It has even warned against taking supplements for
